card.name: Verb after a drug name as subject
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug or drug class used as a sentence subject, usually a verb or linking word such as has, with, can, may, have or exhibited. It appears in pharmacology text describing what a drug does.

modes.label: Linking word after drug
modes.description: A word like 'with' follows a drug description, introducing its effects.
modes.example: OSPHENA is an estrogen agonist/antagonist<< with>> tissue selective effects.

modes.label: Verb after drug subject
modes.description: A verb such as has, can, may or exhibited follows a drug or drug class as subject.
